Class BankAccountService

public inherited sharing class BankAccountService

Service for BankAccount__c. Encapsulates business operations on bank-account records — currently, enforcing the single-default-per-scope invariant by promoting a chosen bank account and demoting any peer records that share its scope (record type for Mercury, parent venue for ACH and Link).

Methods

public static Boolean makeDefault(Id bankAccountId)

Marks the given BankAccount__c as the default within its scope and demotes any peer records currently flagged as default. Scope is derived from record type: Mercury accounts compete across the org, while every other record type competes within a single parent venue (Account__c).

The DML is delegated to updateBankAccounts, which runs it in AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE with BankAccountTriggerHandler.afterUpdate bypassed (via TriggerHandler.BypassScope) so the updates do not re-enter runAfterLogic. DML uses allOrNone=false; per-record failures are logged via ErrorUtils and reflected in the returned flag.

Parameters:
    bankAccountId – Record Id of the BankAccount__c to promote to default

Returns:
    Boolean: true when no DML was needed or every record saved successfully; false when at least one record failed


@TestVisible
private static Boolean updateBankAccounts(List<BankAccount__c> bankAccounts)

Bulk-updates the given bank-account records with BankAccountTriggerHandler.afterUpdate bypassed (via TriggerHandler.BypassScope, so an upstream bypass is preserved) and DML running in AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE. Inspects each Database.SaveResult; failures are logged via ErrorUtils and the method returns false if any record failed. The bypass is released in a finally block.

Parameters:
    bankAccounts – Bank-account records to update

Returns:
    Boolean: true when every record saved successfully; false when at least one record failed
